manualFollowUps: Ships as an update after the Schood AI release (#334, everything off). Nothing goes on sale and nobody new gets AI from this release: every product it adds is draft, every plan inactive, and the launch switch stays off until the owner runs ai_pricing_launch(true).

Pages: merging publishes schood-ai with /pricing (and /plans), /pricing/done and /gift, and the platform with a Schood AI group on its pricing page (empty until launch, because the products are drafts). Until the function below is deployed, /pricing on ai.schood.online shows its connection error state; nothing else changes.

Database: supabase db push --linked from an isolated copy that adds only 20261030500000_schood_ai_pricing.sql to the installed migrations, keeping Codex's 9 pending #220 payment migrations (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. It inserts 17 Schood AI products (status draft) and 28 plans (is_active false) with deterministic md5 ids at the doc's UZS prices; adds ai_pricing_fulfilments and ai_pricing_gifts (RLS on, service role read-only, written only through SECURITY DEFINER functions); the functions ai_pricing_terms, ai_pricing_fulfil, ai_pricing_sync, ai_pricing_sync_due, ai_pricing_gift_set_hash, ai_pricing_redeem, ai_pricing_team_setup, ai_pricing_launch (database owner only) and ai_pricing_erase_account (registered in account_erasure_service_hooks()). It reads public.payments and never locks or writes it; a gift redemption writes entitlements the way payment fulfilment does (source 'gift'). It does not touch the Click function, the #220 migrations or any existing product or plan.

Secrets: none new and none to change. index.ts changed, so the release check lists every setting it reads, all set (or deliberately unset) by #334: supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://ai.schood.online and supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_SERVICE_SECRET=<value> stay as they are; supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_BETA_USER_IDS=<testers> and supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_GLOBAL_DAILY_CALLS=<ceiling> stay as they are. The product ids are no longer needed: the function uses the migration's ids. Leave them unset; supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_PLUS_PRODUCT_ID=, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_FAMILY_PRODUCT_ID=, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_TEACHER_PRODUCT_ID=, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_TEACHER_PRO_PRODUCT_ID=, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_CENTRE_PRODUCT_ID= and supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_CENTRE_PRO_PRODUCT_ID= are only for pointing a plan at a product made by hand (SCHOOD_AI_COACH_PASS_PRODUCT_IDS likewise only adds passes).

Function: supabase functions deploy schood-ai --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel. It adds the pricing area (pricing/catalog anonymous, pricing/me, pricing/sync, pricing/gift-redeem, pricing/team-setup), the pricing.sync job on the existing system tick (every five minutes, fulfils paid credit packs, gift codes, sittings and team orders once per payment), the launch switch in plan resolution (off: only Schood admins and SCHOOD_AI_BETA_USER_IDS, exactly as before this release), engage's certificate-sitting and annual-offer sources, and the coach bots' paywall link to /pricing.

Launch (owner decision, later, not part of this release): after confirming the prices (edit amounts in public.plans if needed), run select public.ai_pricing_launch(true); in the Supabase SQL editor. One transaction sets ai_settings.features['pricing.launch'] (plan-based access for everyone; the beta list becomes optional), activates the 14 self-serve products and their plans (centre plans and add-ons stay granted by support) and audits pricing.launch. Within 30 seconds /pricing shows Buy buttons and the platform's pricing page lists Schood AI Plus. To withdraw: select public.ai_pricing_launch(false);. The 'Ask Schood AI' links in the seven other apps are separate: CI builds them with VITE_SCHOOD_AI_LINKS=1 (add VITE_SCHOOD_AI_LINKS: ${{ vars.VITE_SCHOOD_AI_LINKS || '0' }} to the build env in deploy-pages.yml, set the repository variable to 1, and let the next main deploy rebuild them).

Click checkout must accept these plans when they go on sale: CLICK must be configured (static IP egress) as for every other Schood product; nothing in this release changes the click function or payment fulfilment.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261030500000 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.

select count(*) from public.products where metadata->>'service' = 'schood-ai' and status = 'draft' returns 17; select count(*) from public.plans where metadata->>'service' = 'schood-ai' and is_active returns 0; select (features ? 'pricing.launch') from public.ai_settings returns false.

select public.account_erasure_service_hooks() includes ai_pricing_erase_account; anon REST GET /rest/v1/ai_pricing_gifts answers 401 or permission denied; GET /rest/v1/products?id=eq.6b7cb4f9-c615-1976-3183-2f6d030f6e1c returns [] (the Plus draft is not public).
Fifteen minutes after the function deploys, select job, last_status from public.ai_system_runs where job = 'pricing.sync' shows ok.

On ai.schood.online signed out and signed in (not a tester): /pricing lists every plan at its price with 'Not on sale yet' and the 'Plans are not on sale yet' note; the assistant still shows the paywall; a beta tester still chats as before.
schood.online/pricing and the home page show no Schood AI card before launch.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages: roll schood-ai and platform back to their previous deployments; the pricing screens and the platform group are additive.
rollback.migration: Additive: leave the rows (drafts and inactive plans are invisible; catalogue rows cannot be hard-deleted). If launched, select public.ai_pricing_launch(false); takes everything off sale and clears the switch.
rollback.function: Redeploy the previous schood-ai function: pricing routes answer not_found, the pricing.sync job is no longer registered, and plan resolution returns to the SCHOOD_AI_*_PRODUCT_ID settings (unset: only beta testers).
